edbDesc: The ability of substance to change color due to a change in temperature. Thermochromism is one of several types of chromism. The two basic approaches are based on liquid crystals and leuco dyes.
title: Thermochromism
description: Some dyes and crystals change colour as they warm or cool, so a surface can show its temperature at a glance. It's what makes mood rings and colour-changing mugs shift, and what reads a child's fever on a strip pressed to the forehead.
effect: a material changes colour with temperature
strength: The colour shifts over a span of just a few degrees, enough to read body temperature to about half a degree.
pickWhy: Borderline: Clear detecting job, but no single discoverer or date (Reinitzer's 1888 liquid crystals and older colour-changing salts both count), so left null.
